_comment: Classifying is done by a Claude Code session or sub-agents, never by an API key from this process: `npm run classify` writes data/classify-queue.ndjson and data/classify-instructions.md, and the answers go into data/classify-answers.ndjson. prompt_version is part of the cache key: bump it when you change the prompt in src/lib/classification.js so cached results are recomputed.
